svg.title: Same question, different answers: GLP-1 GI risk by study
svg.desc: Same question, different answers: GLP-1 GI risk by study. Pancreatitis, JAMA 2023 letter (vs bupropion-naltrexone): 9.09 (1.25-66.0). Pancreatitis, Dig Dis Sci 2026 (TriNetX, vs no GLP-1): 2.85 (1.82-4.48). Pancreatitis, Shanghai preprint 2026 (vs DPP-4i): 1.31 (0.74-2.34). Pancreatitis, Meta-analysis, 52 obesity studies (2026): 1.29 (0.91-1.84). Bowel obstruction, JAMA 2023 letter (vs bupropion-naltrexone): 4.22 (1.02-17.4). Bowel obstruction, Meta-analysis, 6 studies (2026): 1.95 (0.43-8.79). Bowel obstruction, Shanghai preprint 2026 (vs DPP-4i): 1.02 (0.6-1.74). Bowel obstruction, Dig Dis Sci 2026 (TriNetX, vs no GLP-1): 0.86 (0.8-0.92). Gastroparesis, JAMA 2023 letter (vs bupropion-naltrexone): 3.67 (1.15-11.9). Gastroparesis, Shanghai preprint 2026 (vs DPP-4i): 1.99 (1.4-2.81). Gastroparesis, Dig Dis Sci 2026 (TriNetX, vs no GLP-1): 1.57 (1.43-1.73).
